account.deleteConfirm: Button in a confirmation dialog that permanently deletes the person's account.
account.signOut: Button: log out of the app.
chat.toCrew: Accessibility label for the message box in a crew's chat.
chat.toGroup: Accessibility label for the message box in an outing group's chat.
chat.typing: Under the messages while someone else in the chat is typing. {name} is their first name.
chat.typingMany: Under the messages while two or more others are typing. {count} is 2 or more.
common.back: Button: go back to the previous screen.
common.close: Button: close a sheet or panel.
common.continue: Button: go to the next step of a form.
common.none: Shown when a list or setting is empty.
common.retry: Button after something failed to load.
common.save: Button: store the changes made on this screen (not saving money).
common.saved: Short confirmation after the changes were stored.
crew.accept: Button answering an invitation to join a crew (a small, ongoing group chat of people who met at an outing).
crew.chat: Title of a crew's group chat. A crew is a small, ongoing group of people who met at an outing.
crew.deciding: Status next to a member's name while they haven't answered the crew invitation yet. Lower case, one word if possible.
crew.decidingNames: Names of crew members who haven't answered yet, joined with commas.
crew.decline: Button declining an invitation to join a crew.
crew.name: Name of a crew, built from an activity or place, e.g. 'Bouldering crew'. {name} goes first.
crew.noSuggestion: Shown on a crew's plans tab before any plan has been suggested.
crew.offerEyebrow: Small line above the name of a crew someone has been offered.
crew.openChat: Button shown once a crew has started.
crew.saidYes: Under a crew member's name: they accepted the crew. Lowercase, a short state.
crew.saidYesNames: Names of crew members who accepted, joined with commas.
crew.settings: Accessibility label for the button that shows report and leave options for a crew.
crew.share: Label above what brought a crew together (an activity or an area).
crew.shareActivity: Why a crew was put together: they share an activity.
crew.shareArea: Why a crew was put together: they live in the same area.
crew.soFar: Label above who has answered a crew offer.
crew.suggestedBefore: Heading above plans suggested to a crew earlier.
crew.tabs: Accessibility label for the switch between a crew's chat and its plans.
crew.yesCount: How many of the three yeses a crew needs to start it have come in.
crew.you: Marks the person themselves in a list of members, e.g. 'Aiko (you)'. Lower case.
crew.youSaidYes: Button after the person accepted a crew.
crew.yourCrew: Small line above the name of a crew that has started.
event.cancel: Button: give up your confirmed place at an outing.
event.checkIn: Button pressed on arrival at the meeting point, to say you are there.
event.checkInLater: On the day of an outing, before check-in opens.
event.confirm: Button answering 'Can you go?' for an outing with a set date.
event.decline: Button answering 'Can you go?' for an outing with a set date.
event.feedback: Button that opens the feedback form after an outing.
event.going: Heading above the list of people going to the outing.
event.ifYouGo: Heading above what happens after saying yes to an outing date.
event.ifYouGoBody: What happens after saying yes to an outing date.
event.meetingPointFirstStop: Where the group meets: at the first stop of the outing's itinerary.
event.openChat: Link on the day of an outing.
event.share: Button: share the outing's details (place and time) with a friend or family member for safety.
event.startsIn: Countdown to an outing's start, on the day.
event.tabPlan: Tab on an outing screen showing the plan's details.
event.tabs: Accessibility label for the switch between an outing's chat and its plan.
events.title: Tab and screen title listing the outings the person has joined.
feed.list: Toggle between showing plans as a list or on a map.
feed.map: Toggle between showing plans as a list or on a map.
feed.title: Main screen title. A plan is a suggested outing that people sign up for before it has a date.
feedback.rating1: One of five rating labels for an outing, from worst (1) to best (5).
feedback.rating2: One of five rating labels for an outing, from worst (1) to best (5).
feedback.rating3: One of five rating labels for an outing, from worst (1) to best (5).
feedback.rating4: One of five rating labels for an outing, from worst (1) to best (5).
feedback.rating5: One of five rating labels for an outing, from worst (1) to best (5).
interest.like: One of three levels of interest in an activity: open to try < I like it < I love it.
interest.love: One of three levels of interest in an activity: open to try < I like it < I love it.
interest.openToTry: One of three levels of interest in an activity: open to try < I like it < I love it.
interest.tapClear: Tapping an activity tile cycles through the interest levels; a fourth tap removes it.
language.fluent: How well the person speaks a language: fluent, or still learning.
language.learning: How well the person speaks a language: fluent, or still learning (not 'studying a subject').
language.level.1: Level of a language the person is learning.
language.level.2: Level of a language the person is learning.
language.level.3: Level of a language the person is learning.
language.remove: Button removing a language from the person's list.
language.switch: Button switching the text between the person's two display languages.
leave.confirm: Button in a dialog: leave the crew.
map.sheet: Accessibility label for the sheet of plans over the map, before an area is picked; people can swipe it up or down to resize it.
onboarding.finish: Button on the last step of setting up a profile.
plan.finishHere: Label on the last stop of an outing's itinerary: the outing ends at this place.
plan.friends: People the person got on with at earlier outings are interested in this plan. count is how many (1 or more).
plan.hideStops: Link that hides a plan's map and stops.
plan.interested: Number of people who signed up for a plan so far.
plan.length: Heading for how long the outing lasts.
plan.meetHere: Label on the first stop of an outing's itinerary: the group meets at this place.
plan.minutes: Travel time from the person's area to the plan.
plan.nearby: Travel time label when the plan is in the person's own area.
plan.next: Under the sign-up button: what happens when you tap it.
plan.seeStops: Link that shows a plan's map and stops.
plan.signUp: Button: say you'd like to go to this plan (no commitment yet; the date is chosen later).
plan.signUpHint: Under the button that saves a sign-up.
plan.stay: Time spent at one stop of the itinerary.
plan.theStops: Heading above a plan's places, in order.
plan.theWalk: Heading above a walk's stops, in order.
plan.when: Heading for when the plan can happen.
plan.where: Heading for where the plan happens.
plan.wholeDay: Selects every time slot of a day at once.
plan.withdraw: Button: withdraw your sign-up for a plan.
plans.friends: Section of plans that people the person met before and liked are interested in.
plans.nearby: Filter chip: only plans within 30 minutes' travel.
plans.noMatch: Shown when search and filters leave no plans.
plans.other: Section of plans for activities the person hasn't rated.
plans.search: Accessibility label for the plan search box.
plans.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder in the plan search box.
plans.title: Title of the Plans screen.
profile.block.afternoon: Part of a day in a weekly availability grid.
profile.block.evening: Part of a day in a weekly availability grid.
profile.block.morning: Part of a day in a weekly availability grid.
profile.budget.0: How much the person wants to spend per outing: free.
profile.budget.1: How much the person wants to spend per outing.
profile.budget.2: How much the person wants to spend per outing.
profile.budget.3: How much the person wants to spend per outing.
profile.energy: How energetic the person likes outings to be.
profile.energy.1: How energetic the person likes outings to be: calm and relaxed.
profile.energy.2: How energetic the person likes outings to be.
profile.energy.3: How energetic the person likes outings to be: physically active.
profile.homeArea: Field label: the neighbourhood the person usually starts from.
profile.maxTravel: The longest travel time the person accepts to reach an outing.
report.reasonDating: Reason for reporting someone: they came looking for a date rather than friends.
report.send: Button: send the report to moderators.
share.intro: First line of a message the person sends to a friend; {title} is the outing's name.
signIn.codeLabel: Field label for the one-time code sent by email.
signIn.resend: Button: send the sign-in code again.
signIn.sendCode: Button: email a one-time sign-in code.
suggest.add: Button: add the suggested activities to the person's interests.
suggest.dismiss: Button: close the suggestions without adding them.
tabs.needsYou: Accessibility label for the badge on the Together tab.
tabs.plans: Tab: plans to sign up for.
tabs.together: Tab: your outings, crews and anything that needs an answer.
thread.dateSet: Stage of an outing: a date has been chosen.
thread.going: Stage of an outing: the person said they'll go.
thread.howWasIt: Stage of an outing: afterwards, giving feedback.
thread.label: Accessibility label for the outing progress line.
thread.onTheDay: Stage of an outing: it's today.
thread.signedUp: Stage of an outing: the person signed up for the plan.
together.checkIn: Under an outing that's on today.
together.groups: Heading above the person's outings and crews.
together.intro: Intro on the Together screen before the first sign-up.
together.needsYou: Heading above invitations and questions waiting for the person's answer.
together.otherPlans: Link from the Together screen to the Plans tab.
together.picks: Heading above a few suggested plans.
together.seePlans: Button from the Together screen to the Plans tab.
together.step1: First step of how Issho works.
together.step2: Second step of how Issho works.
together.step3: Third step of how Issho works.
together.title: Title of the Together screen.
together.waiting: Heading above plans the person signed up for that don't have a date yet.
you.account: Heading above sign out and delete account.
you.appearanceSystem: Appearance option: follow the phone's light or dark setting.
you.crews: How many crews the person is in.
you.howYouMeet: Heading above the profile settings that shape who you're matched with.
you.secondLanguage: Label for the person's second language.
you.slots: How many weekly time slots the person is usually free.
you.title: Title of the You screen.
